notes.title: Cyber Manhunt 2: New World - The Wait is Over, Full Release is Here!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Cyber Detectives!

We’re thrilled to announce that Cyber Manhunt 2: New World is now officially in full release!

With the addition of Chapter 5, Cyber Manhunt 2: New World has reached its complete version, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you. This latest chapter brings the total estimated playtime to approximately 10–13 hours, offering an even richer and more immersive experience!
To celebrate the launch, we’re offering an exclusive 12% discount for the first two weeks, bringing the price down to just $8.79 USD.
Additionally, players who own the first game can enjoy the Cyber Manhunt Complete Saga Bundle, which come with an extra 15% discount on top of the launch promotion!
Don’t wait too long—these offers are only available during the two-week launch promotion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/0c7d94e4010ebc1ea00fe05e0841d19db67ff67c.png

Watch Our Thrilling launch trailer!

[previewyoutube=IXz7CayhVKw;full][/previewyoutube]

About The Game

Since its Early Access debut, Cyber Manhunt 2: New World has received widespread acclaim from players and media alike for its intense, thrilling social engineering gameplay and its thought-provoking exploration of societal issues. On Steam, the game boasts an impressive 93% "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating.
Building upon the world established by its predecessor, the game delves deeper into the profound impacts of rapid advancements in the internet and AI technologies in an era where "data is power."

In Cyber Manhunt 2: New World, players take on the role of an AI detective, tasked with unraveling digital mysteries and uncovering hidden truths. Employ real-world social engineering tactics and AI-driven investigative techniques to solve complex, intriguing puzzles and uncover layers of a gripping narrative. Every revelation not only leads to shocking discoveries but also exposes a vast, deeply interconnected conspiracy.

Become A "True Hacker"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/b1d323bff4031c78ed1e7037791bbd122634d901.png

Immerse yourself in the digital realm as an AI detective, uncovering deep-seated mysteries inspired by real-world incidents. Experience the thrill of solving intricate puzzles that demand clever thinking and strategic planning.

Advanced Hacking Techniques

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/f45a5742730949e5c66b9dc30cc40a3f01fe11fa.png

From basic techniques to more sophisticated methods like voice masking, embody the essence of a true hacker. These varied tactics, ranging from password cracking to crafting digital personas, are essential in successfully navigating and solving each intricate case.

Compelling, Interwoven Story

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/8050c765f492486940100096c096611cb42fce59.png

Dive into a narrative that draws its inspiration from real-world events, where each chapter seamlessly contributes to an overarching and intricate plot. Experience the emotional and psychological intricacies of each character, leading you through a complex web of conspiracy.

A Spectrum of Lives

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/4850d17396a7a607660c1a2886f8392e40e732b6.png

Encounter a diverse cast of unique individuals, each representing different societal roles, motives, and histories. In this era of advanced AI, uncover the secrets they conceal, exposing the multifaceted nature of their digital lives—where there’s always more than meets the eye.

Upcoming Updates!

In the future, we’ll be releasing a free update for the DLC desktop pet, along with the free launch of the Cyber Manhunt 2: New World original soundtrack.
Stay tuned for more updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/faa9cc41593abad506b3a9f3a2d380359e9e4ddb.png

If you’re ready to immerse yourself in a thrilling journey of investigation and privacy invasion while exploring profound reflections on humanity, technology, and moral choices, we invite you to dive into the story-driven puzzle game Cyber Manhunt 2: New World.

Be sure to follow our official accounts below to stay updated with the latest game news and updates.

Welcome To The New World!

notes.title: Full Release of Sequel "Cyber Manhunt 2: New World" on 21 Jan!
notes.notes:
The narrative-heavy puzzle game Cyber Manhunt 2: New World, developed by the indie game team, Aluba Studio, and published by Spiral Up Games, will update the fifth and final chapter on Steam on January 21st, and transition from Early Access to Full Release.

Enjoy an all-time high discount of 12% off your purchase during the launch period, making it USD 8.79 for two whole weeks! 

In addition, players of the first Cyber Manhunt game can purchase the "Cyber Manhunt Complete Saga" bundle to complete your collection. Pair this with the release discount, you will get to enjoy a super discount and the price of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World will only be USD 7.47!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/2b096cf033b49bff00da3a16304410a44a13b298.png
But what is Cyber Manhunt 2: New World about? Click the link below and find out in our brand new trailer!
[previewyoutube=UT8iqe0H57g;full][/previewyoutube]
The official release of Cyber Manhunt 2: New World includes all the content from the prologue to the fifth chapter, with an expected gameplay length of 10-13 hours. 

Please note that after the discount period, the game's price will increase from USD 9.99 to USD 12.99 so make sure not to miss your chance to purchase it in the first two weeks of our official launch!

Since the release of the early access game, Cyber Manhunt 2: New World has won high praise from players and critics alike for its thrilling hacking gameplay and in-depth exploration of controversial social issues. It also received 93% positive reviews on Steam. With the intricate world of the first game as its foundations, the sequel further delves into the extensive and profound impact of the rapid development of AI technology in an era where data is power.

Step into the shoes of an AI assistant — crack passwords and private information of persons of interest through online search and social media. Unravel their habits, history and interpersonal relationships, and dig out the secrets they want to hide. Can you uncover the truth buried behind a series of bizarre events?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/7251ca379256138b170f8caf203f4b788c20b575.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/8ce1cb07058af20db357902cc5ea36d3dedcc3ce.png
If you are eager to experience this immersive investigative journey firsthand and embark on a deep reflection on human nature, technology, and moral choices -

We welcome you to click the link on the Steam store page below to get your hands on the story-driven puzzle game Cyber Manhunt 2: New World. 

Do you have the intellect to uncover the truth and, more importantly, do you have what it takes to handle the reality you may find?

notes.title: Cyber Manhunt is transitioned to Full Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you so much for your support and help. There is almost half year since Early Access was launched, and two years since we started to build this game. It was not easy to do it during this period, but it is worth because of your recognition.
We have finished five chapters in the game and also major bugs were fixed, so we decided to transition the game to Full Release today. But it does not mean the game is over, my team will focus working on DLCs. Hope you guys will like it.
Please feel free to let me know if you have questions or issues in the game. We will try to fix it ASAP.

Email: cmh@mysgame.top
